title: 第25章 跑路咯
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
后续矿场如何，已和遁远的楚星尘也暂无关系了。

    日夜兼程下。

    此刻楚星尘已经带着自家弟子重新遁回破庙之内。

    破庙内的宁芊芊此刻听见动静，连忙走出破庙，看见四人，尤其是看见厉行天身后背着的一位男人。

    虽然宁坤身穿破旧衣服，也瘦了许多，宁芊芊看见心心念念的父亲时，还是第一眼就认出了他。

    宁芊芊连忙跪下朝楚星尘磕头，忍不住哭泣道：

    “多谢大仙……多谢大仙……”

    厉行天将身后背着的人轻轻轻轻放在了宁芊芊的面前。

    宁坤此刻正处于昏迷状态，不过是被楚星尘特意弄昏过去，跑路时刻自己可没那么多时间解释什么。

    楚星尘抬手施法，将宁坤唤醒。

    一声轻咳，宁坤缓缓睁开眼，先映入眼帘的是自家的女儿梨花带泪的脸。

    楚星尘看见宁坤醒来后连忙开口：

    “我现在没空听你们父女两继续煽情。”

    这话让宁芊芊和宁坤许多想说的话，瞬间顿住，纷纷将目光望向楚星尘。

    “我不指望你们能报答我什么，如今也算我做一件好事，只要你们来日万一被清风宗抓了，别把我供出来便是。”

    楚星尘说着，从空间戒指之中拿出水壶和粮食，以及一些散碎银两：

    “你也有炼气二层修为，从这顺着东走便有人烟，有这些食物和水足以支撑你们走到，用这些银子自谋生路去，不过跑的远些才更安全。”

    “姑且算我救人救到尾，一切话都不必多说，拿上这些东西现在就走。你们父女有什么话路上再说。”

    宁芊芊自是懂楚星尘的意思，事情尘埃落定之后，恐怕清风宗的报复就在其后。

    楚星尘自然不可能看护她和她父亲一辈子，但是能救出她的父亲，宁芊芊已是非常感激戴德。

    她对着楚星尘磕了三个头，随后扶起一旁还没明白情况的父亲：

    “恩公放心，哪怕是死，宁芊芊也绝不会多说一句。”

    楚星尘背过身去，不回答这一句话，算是下了逐客令。

    “父亲……走吧。”宁芊芊低声道，“什么事，路上说。”

    宁坤闻言欲言又止，随后也猛然朝楚星尘磕了头后，才起身跟宁芊芊一同离开。

    随着宁芊芊和宁坤的走远。

    楚星尘猛然回过头，看向自家的大徒弟和二徒弟：

    “走！我们快搬家！这里不安全了！”

    对于自家师父的命令，李应灵严格来说并不算意外。

    说实话，当她看见师父将宁芊芊带回来的那一刻起，就明白，事情完成之后，师父定然会将宗门整个搬走。

    不得不说，宗门小也有好处，三个人背上行囊就是一个宗门。
content_en:
What happens to the mine in the future has nothing to do with Chu Xingchen who has escaped.

Travel day and night.

At this moment, Chu Xingchen had taken his disciples back to the ruined temple.

Ning Qianqian, who was in the ruined temple, heard the noise at this moment and walked out of the ruined temple quickly. She saw four people, especially a man carrying Li Xingtian on his back.

Although Ning Kun was wearing shabby clothes and had lost a lot of weight, Ning Qianqian recognized her father at first sight when she saw her longing for him.

Ning Qianqian quickly knelt down and kowtowed to Chu Xingchen, unable to help but cry:

"Thank you, Immortal... Many thanks, Immortal..."

Li Xingtian gently placed the person he was carrying in front of Ning Qianqian.

Ning Kun was in a coma at the moment, but he was knocked unconscious by Chu Xingchen on purpose. He didn't have much time to explain anything when he was running away.

Chu Xingchen raised his hand and cast a spell to wake up Ning Kun.

With a slight cough, Ning Kun slowly opened his eyes, and the first thing he saw was the tearful face of his daughter Lihua.

When Chu Xingchen saw Ning Kun waking up, he quickly said:

"I don't have time to listen to you father and daughter continue to sensationalize."

These words made Ning Qianqian and Ning Kun pause for a moment as they had many things to say, and both looked at Chu Xingchen.

"I don't expect you to repay me with anything. Now it can be considered a good deed by me, as long as you don't turn me in if you are caught by the Qingfeng Sect in the future."

Chu Xingchen said, taking out a kettle, grain, and some scattered silver from the space ring:

"You also have the second level of Qi Refining. If you walk east from here, there will be people. The food and water will be enough to support you. You can use the money to make a living on your own, but it is safer to run farther away."

"Let's just say that I have saved people to the end. There is no need to say anything more. Just take these things and leave now. If you father and daughter have anything to say, we will talk about it on the way."

Ning Qianqian certainly understood what Chu Xingchen meant. After the matter was settled, Qingfeng Sect's revenge would probably follow.

Of course, Chu Xingchen couldn't take care of her and her father for the rest of their lives, but Ning Qianqian was very grateful to be able to rescue her father.

She kowtowed to Chu Xingchen three times, and then helped her father who didn't understand the situation at the side:

"Don't worry, my benefactor, even if it means death, Ning Qianqian will never say another word."

Chu Xingchen turned his back and did not answer this sentence, which was regarded as an order to expel the guest.

"Father... let's go." Ning Qianqian whispered, "What's the matter? Let's talk about it on the way."

Ning Kun hesitated after hearing this, and then suddenly kowtowed to Chu Xingchen before getting up and leaving with Ning Qianqian.

As Ning Qianqian and Ning Kun walked away.

Chu Xingchen suddenly turned around and looked at his first and second apprentices:

"Let's go! Let's move quickly! It's not safe here!"

Strictly speaking, Li Yingling was not surprised by his master's order.

To be honest, from the moment she saw the master bringing Ning Qianqian back, she knew that after the matter was completed, the master would definitely move the entire sect away.

I have to say that there are advantages to having a small sect. With three people carrying their bags, they become a sect.
